title: Taiwanese American Organization at UC Irvine
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Organization (TAO) at the University of California, Irvine is a student organization founded in April 2009. It serves as UCI’s primary community for Taiwanese Americans and students with an interest in Taiwanese culture, and is listed among the Asian American organizations recognized by the UCI School of Humanities.

According to the organization’s own website, TAO’s purpose is to provide community, educate members on Taiwanese culture, history, and current events, and to serve as a bridge connecting members to other Taiwanese-affiliated organizations through community service and activities. Recurring programs include an annual Big Bear Trip, an End of the Year Banquet, dumpling nights, hotpot evenings, weekly general meetings, bonfires, and other social events.

TAO has maintained connections to the broader Taiwanese American community. The organization is a member of the Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Student Association (ITASA) network, and in its early years was recognized as a best new TASA by that body. Members have also participated in civic initiatives including the Taiwanese American Citizens League’s census project.
